_COMMENT_LAYERS: Two-layer product, chocolate on the TX (top) side. LAYERS are listed TOP to BOTTOM; SIZE's thickness must equal the layer sum (checked in EMSimulation.__init__). Each layer gets its own Debye mixture and its own gprMax material/geometry (sut_0, sut_1, ...). The centered foreign object (POSITION_RELATIVE z = 0.5 -> 5 mm above the belt) therefore sits in the 8 mm waffle layer.
_COMMENT_SOURCE_CHOCOLATE: Milk chocolate, typical literature values (~1 % water, ~7.7 % protein, ~30 % fat, ~52 % sugar, remaining carbohydrate/cocoa solids lumped into STARCH, ~0.3 % salt). The page fetched for this product failed, so these are NOT taken from a fetched source - verify against the supplier's spec sheet.
_COMMENT_SOURCE_WAFFLE: Same estimate as cookie_waffle.json (including the porosity caveat).
_COMMENT_GRID: 50 mm footprint -> 70 mm domain (same ~5 mm PML clearance as the earlier 30 mm cylinder); see cookie_butter.json.
_COMMENT_AIR: Chocolate layer: solid (AIR_VOLUME_FRACTION 0). Waffle layer: 0.825, midpoint of the 77-88 % range stated by Konstantin (2026-09-21) - see cookie_waffle.json. Recipes are MASS fractions of the solids (converted to volume fractions + air by the study).
